title: Record concrete toolchain identity in portfolio Reports
description:
As an optimization operator, I want every portfolio Report to identify the Plexus and Tactus code that produced it, so that findings and optimizer decisions can be reproduced and audited.

Feature: Optimization toolchain identity

Scenario: Caller omits toolchain identity
  Given a portfolio procedure is launched through the supported runtime
  When the frozen run specification is created
  Then it records the installed Plexus version
  And it records the loaded Tactus version
  And it does not publish the value unknown

Scenario: Explicit build identity is available
  Given a deployment provides an immutable build revision
  When the toolchain identity is recorded
  Then the immutable build revision is included with package versions

Scenario: Run resumes
  Given a living Report has frozen a toolchain identity
  When the same attempt resumes
  Then the stored identity remains unchanged
  And a changed runtime identity cannot silently rewrite prior evidence

Out of scope: schema resources, deployment, source mutation, automatic promotion, and client-specific data.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Board audit 2026-10-17: verified against develop. The frozen run spec and run key now record concrete primus/ and tactus/ package versions plus an immutable build revision when available (portfolio_run._toolchain_version). Covered by portfolio_run_test toolchain tests; changed identity on resume is rejected by the existing frozen-spec checks in run_report_test.
